. ( yaad kero ) woh waqiaa jo dil dehla ker rakh dey ga !
kiya hai woh dil dehlaney wala waqiaa-?
aur tumhen kiya maloom woh dil dehlaney wala waqiaa kiya hai ?
jiss din saray log phelay huye perwanon ki tarah hojayen gay ,
aur pahar dhunki hoi rangeen oon ki tarah hojayen gay ,
abb jiss shaks kay palray wazni hon gay
to woh mann pasand zindagi mein hoga ,
aur woh jiss kay palray halkay hon gay
to uss ka thikana aik gehra garrha hoga .
aur tumhen kiya maloom kay woh gehra garrha kiya cheez hai-?
